node.label: Glomerular crescent formation
node.definition: Glomerular crescent refers hyperplastic lesions involving 10% or more of the circumference of Bowman's capsule. Crescents can be composed of a variable mixture of epithelial/leukocyte hypercellularity, fibrous matrix, and fibrin.

evidence.snippet: Systemic lupus erythematosus 18: Glomerular crescent formation (frequency 2/2) [PCS]
